meta.title: 123Band
meta.description: Latin festival event passes, tickets & gear in one place.

intro.heading: Finding the right festival shouldn't be a gamble
intro.lead: Tired of confusing info, bad schedules, or empty dance floors? You're in the right place.
intro.body: 123Band is your cheat sheet for the Asian Latin dance scene. Curated by artists with 12+ years of experience, we cut through the noise to bring you the raw, unfiltered truth about where to dance next.

items.title: Real Vibe Checks
items.desc: POV vlogs of venues & parties. See the crowd before you book.

items.title: Local Guides
items.desc: Best food & stays near the venue. No tourist traps.

items.title: Exclusive Discounts
items.desc: We negotiate the best deals on Full & VIP passes for you.

items.title: Highlights
items.desc: The best demos & social dancing from Asia & beyond.

closing.lead: Whether you dance Salsa, Bachata, or Kizomba, we help you travel smarter and dance better.
closing.emphasis: Don't book your next pass without checking 123Band first.

jnj.title: J&J Championships
jnj.intro: Random partners, one song, one shot. Every J&J held at a 123Band festival — the format, the rules, and everyone who made the podium.
jnj.hallOfFameSub: Celebrating excellence on the social dance floor
jnj.signupSub: Sign up for this division. Members only — log in first, then the form opens in a new tab.
jnj.signupLoginRequired: Log in to sign up for this division.
jnj.voteSub: Judge this division from the audience. Members go straight to the scoring screen — no sign-up form. Audience judging takes place during the event — just follow the MC's instructions.
jnj.voteLoginRequired: Log in to go straight to the scoring screen.

jnj.reviewsSub: Competed or watched this division? Share your experience.
jnj.reviewPlaceholder: Tell us about the organization, judging, atmosphere...
jnj.resultsSub: Every round — prelims, semi-finals and finals, exactly as the judges scored them.
jnj.breakdownNote: Judges are listed anonymously, in panel order. The bottom row is the column average — so the last cell is the total above.
jnj.breakdownNoteNamed: Judges are listed by name, in panel order. The bottom row is the column average — so the last cell is the total above.
jnj.videosSub: Footage from this J&J. Division videos come first when they exist.
jnj.noWinnersHint: The podium is published once the organiser confirms the final scores.
jnj.noJudgesHint: The panel is published once the organiser confirms it.
jnj.noEditionsHint: Competition details will appear here as soon as the first edition is published.
jnj.invite: Dancers sign up for the fun of it at every festival. The scores come back as feedback on how your dancing actually reads, and every round leaves you a step further along. Take the shot — that is where the next kind of fun begins.
